name: Relaxation Yuka You ~Hitozuma Therapist-tachi ni Yoru Iyashi no Jikan~
original_name: リラクゼーション癒香・陽 ～人妻セラピスト達による癒しの時間～
source:
“I… I’m actually a little confident in this area, you know?”

For salaryman Hasegawa Kazuya, his weekly treat is visiting the massage parlor “Relaxation Yuka.” After work, he’d drop by for a session with the owner, Yuka, or one of her staff, Aya. The massages were relaxing, and the extra “services” were just the cherry on top—a little reward and escape from his daily grind.

One day, a new staff member, Saki, joins the parlor. At Yuka’s request, Kazuya agrees to be Saki’s first client. Her massage skills are still rough, but her other “techniques” are surprisingly skilled. And when he gets a rare session with Kana, another staff member, Kazuya finds himself falling deeper and deeper into the allure of Relaxation Yuka…

“What you’re touching right now… is my butt, you know?”

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01096367.html]dlsite[/url]]
